title: Granite Cave Life
context: Rocky caves shelter some hardy neighbors.
objective: Visit GRANITE CAVE with a ROCK-type partner in your party.
hint: GEODUDE can be found in the cave.

title: Tidal Pool Records
context: Our island waters support very different swimmers.
objective: Record TENTACOOL and MAGIKARP as caught in your POKéDEX.
hint: Try the OLD ROD around DEWFORD. Earlier catches count.

title: Meadow Sparks
context: The meadows near MAUVILLE crackle with life.
objective: Visit ROUTE 110 with an ELECTRIC-type partner in your party.
hint: ELECTRIKE makes a fine guide to its home.

title: Dryland Partners
context: Dry country asks a lot of its inhabitants.
objective: Visit ROUTE 111 with a GROUND-type partner in your party.
hint: NUMEL or SANDSHREW can help with this survey.

title: Riverbank Survey
context: Riverbanks link the forest to the water.
objective: Visit ROUTE 119 with a GRASS-type partner in your party.
hint: A partner from an earlier route is welcome too.

title: Weather Partners
gate_text: Help the WEATHER INSTITUTE and receive CASTFORM.
context: The WEATHER INSTITUTE studies a remarkable partner.
objective: Visit ROUTE 119 with CASTFORM in your party.
hint: Any of CASTFORM's weather forms can help.

title: Canopy Travelers
context: The canopy has paths we cannot walk.
objective: Visit ROUTE 120 with a FLYING-type partner in your party.
hint: You need only observe your partner; no move is required.

title: Quiet Mountain
context: MT. PYRE deserves a quiet and respectful visit.
objective: Visit the exterior of MT. PYRE with a GHOST-type partner.
hint: SHUPPET and DUSKULL live in the mountain.

title: Offshore Partners
context: The open sea is another part of our field atlas.
objective: Visit ROUTE 124 with a WATER-type partner in your party.
hint: SURF along the route; diving is not required.

title: Shoal Cave Voices
gate_text: Help STEVEN at the SPACE CENTER.
context: Tides change the rooms in SHOAL CAVE.
objective: Visit the cave entrance with an ICE-type partner.
hint: Either tide is fine. SPHEAL is a local resident.

title: Peaceful Waters
context: With the skies calm again, we can observe gently.
objective: Visit SOOTOPOLIS CITY with a WATER-type partner.
hint: The city's lake is part of its everyday life too.

title: Hoenn Field Atlas
gate_text: Become CHAMPION and finish the other 17 BIRCH requests.
context: Your earlier reports can become a regional atlas.
objective: Record at least 60 HOENN species as caught, then report to me.
hint: Earlier catches count. Keep every POKéMON.

title: Tunnel Acoustics
gate_text: Meet MR. STONE and receive the POKéNAV.
context: Your help in the tunnel gave our staff an idea.
objective: Visit RUSTURF TUNNEL with WHISMUR in your party.
hint: We need a field note, not a POKéMON handover.

title: Steel Under Stone
context: STEVEN's cave studies inspire our materials team.
objective: Visit GRANITE CAVE with a STEEL-type partner.
hint: ARON lives in the cave. Keep your partner afterward.

title: Harbor Field Test
gate_text: Deliver the DEVON GOODS to CAPT. STERN.
context: CAPT. STERN needs equipment suited to coastal work.
objective: Visit ROUTE 109 with a WATER-type partner.
hint: Observe the partner on the beach; no samples are taken.

title: Current Conductors
context: A controlled current can teach our engineers a lot.
objective: Show me a party POKéMON that knows THUNDER WAVE.
hint: Do not use it on anyone. A demonstration record will do.

title: Heatproof Materials
context: We test materials for use around volcanic heat.
objective: Visit FIERY PATH with a FIRE-type partner.
hint: NUMEL and SLUGMA are useful guides to the area.

title: Working Waterways
context: Reliable river equipment starts with fieldwork.
objective: Visit ROUTE 118 with a WATER-type partner.
hint: Travel at your own pace; there is no delivery timer.

title: Rain Instruments
gate_text: Help the WEATHER INSTITUTE and receive CASTFORM.
context: The WEATHER INSTITUTE can help calibrate our tools.
objective: Visit ROUTE 119 with CASTFORM in your party.
hint: Our instruments need a partner, not a particular forecast.

title: Flight Recorder
context: We are designing a recorder for aerial journeys.
objective: Show me a party POKéMON that knows FLY.
hint: The move can stay on your partner; nothing is taken.
step: Show MR. STONE the move FLY

title: Power Components
context: Our power systems need a broader research base.
objective: Record MAGNEMITE and VOLTORB as caught in your POKéDEX.
hint: NEW MAUVILLE is home to both. Earlier catches count.

title: Orbital Telemetry
gate_text: Help STEVEN at the SPACE CENTER.
context: The SPACE CENTER can resume its peaceful work.
objective: Visit MOSSDEEP CITY with a PSYCHIC-type partner.
hint: Your observations will help our distant-signal study.

title: Pressure Recorder
context: Our new pressure recorder needs an undersea reading.
objective: Visit UNDERWATER on ROUTE 124 with a WATER-type partner.
hint: Use DIVE where the sea is dark. Return safely.

title: Devon Master Project
gate_text: Become CHAMPION and finish the other 11 DEVON contracts.
context: Your eleven reports have shaped a final research project.
objective: Show me at least 6 different types across your party.
hint: Both types of dual-type partners count. Eggs do not count.
